integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the waist up, solid and naturally proportioned. The camera pushes in at slow speed. <Subject 1> takes a normal breath, then a second, and the chest answers with an unusual inner resonance. <Subject 1> pauses, places a palm on the sternum and taps gently with the fingertips: a low tone like wind across the mouth of a bottle answers from inside the torso. The body still looks completely human. <Subject 1> presses a hand against the abdomen; the surface yields slightly and springs back while a low tone travels through the empty space inside. <Subject 1> bends slowly forward and the torso creaks softly like a hollow vessel changing orientation, then straightens. <Subject 1> raises a hand to the throat and draws in a breath that resonates down through the chest in a long descending tone. In the final moment <Subject 1> exhales slowly through the open mouth for an impossibly long time, the tone rising from far below the body.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, breathing with a deep inner resonance, hollow taps on the chest, and long vessel-like echoes.
